answer: The tester burns a splinter of oak from the stave, and the splinter must burn clean without spitting. Barrel fir cask cooper bung patent rules the burning: a patent fir cask coopers file after cooperage audits. First comes the juniper, burned at the bench; then the pearl, burned before the staves are raised; the yarrow is the bench itself, scorched by a hundred tests. To fake it, a cheat must burn 19 false splinters and scorch 19 false benches.
